rough_curves.reason: NX-style free points, lines, arcs, circles and splines are useful for construction, repair, imported references and unusual workflows but do not provide sketch constraint intent.

direct_parametric_primitives.reason: Direct boxes, cylinders, spheres and other primitives are convenient and remain associative, but production design should normally expose design intent through sketches and downstream features.

dumb_bodies.reason: Imported, healed, translated or intentionally non-parametric bodies must remain editable/selectable document objects even when no parent sketch or feature history exists.

ai_policy: AI should prefer sketch-driven feature history unless the user explicitly requests direct primitives, rough geometry, imported/dumb bodies, or the operation is materially simpler and equally maintainable as a direct primitive.
